title: Vendor DLL ABI defer boundary and branch-isolation contract (PROPOSED, not a decision)
purpose: Record the observed evidence that the vendor DLL ABI half of #9 is unavailable from official sources and is DEFERRED with explicit unlock preconditions.
Record in a tracked artifact that the unknown vendor DLL ABI branch blocks only #27, #28, #73, #74, #76, #77, #78 while the reviewed native wk_model_* C ABI path stays usable.
State explicitly that this record makes no owner decision: it neither closes nor rejects #9, and it does not close #26 or #29.
claim_text: PROPOSED branch-isolation record only: the vendor DLL ABI half of #9 is deferred with five unlock preconditions, the affected tickets stay open and unfixed, #9, #26 and #29 keep their parent dependencies, the native wk_model_* C ABI path is recorded usable and separate from the vendor DLL ABI, and the owner decision stays undecided for both halves.

unlock_preconditions: per-sample manifest: export name, calling convention, pointer/array lengths, float/double/integer types, return type and error codes
units, coordinates, time, ownership and write timing of every input/output field
state diagram for load -> init -> input -> step -> read -> reset new epoch -> terminate/unload
isolation results for DLL crash, step error, short output, repeated reset and thread/UDP residue
file SHA, provenance/license and permitted local use; readable header or wrapper source
vendor_dll_abi_availability.note: Counts are this record's own read of the pinned artifacts; a transmission-layer struct pack letter is not an export signature.

three_way_terrain_shape_contradiction.contradiction: One vendor file states three different terrain shapes across docstring (ii15f), UDP pack (ii20f with a 20-slot fill) and the ctypes export declaration (double[15]); no source in this checkout resolves which surface is authoritative.
three_way_terrain_shape_contradiction.resolution_gap: The terrain shape is unresolved at the export-name level and at the width level, so no vendor terrain channel can be assumed to match the native double[15] terrain argument.
three_way_terrain_shape_contradiction.wksim_native_reason: wksim refuses any terrain_count other than 15 on its own export Simulator/wksim_core/model.cpp:91 and enforces len(terrain) != 15 in Simulator/wksim_core/model.py:153-164, so the vendor contradiction cannot be inherited by the native path.

native_wk_model_abi_path.declared_return_codes: 0 success, 1 invalid arguments, 2 model error, 3 non-finite state
native_wk_model_abi_path.reviewed_evidence_summary: Tracked probe result records status=passed for the native terrain-input seam with a deterministic native-I/O stub.
evidence_that_observation_is_repository_: Every symbol named is declared in this repository's own wrapper source.
The pinned probe result is a tracked repository artifact.
No decision-affecting pin for this observation is a host-external vendor path.

unresolved_blockers.statement: The vendor terrain channel has no single authoritative shape: wrapper docstring says ii15f, the UDP pack uses ii20f with a 20-slot fill, and the ctypes export declaration says double[15], so no vendor terrain mapping may be assumed.
No owner decision exists on whether to keep waiting for or to abandon the legacy/new DLL run path, so #9 cannot be closed on this record.
